question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** "resemblance."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Resemblance"** means similarity or likeness in appearance or character. (सादृश्‍य, समानता)

 
 
• **Example**: *There is a strong **resemblance**__ between the two sisters; they look almost identical.*
 
 
 
• In this context, the word **"resemblance"** is the correct answer.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.
 
• Correct passage:

Amla tree is __considered__ to be thousands of years old. It is called aamaleki and dhaatri in Sanskrit. Its botanical name is Emblica Officinalis. The amla tree is a medium __sized__ tree with citrus fruits. It is found almost everywhere in India __except__ for some very high mountainous regions. It is found __abundantly__ in Madhya Pradesh. The leaves are very small and have a close __**resemblance**__ to those of Gulmohar. The amla tree has slender branches which grow upwards and surround the trees on all sides.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Congruence** means agreement or harmony between two things. (दो चीजों के बीच सहमति या सामंजस्य)
 
• **Harmony** means a pleasing combination of different elements or things. (विभिन्न तत्वों या चीज़ों का मनभावन संयोजन)
 
• **Coincidence** means a remarkable concurrence of events or circumstances without apparent causal connection. (स्पष्ट कारण संबंध के बिना घटनाओं या परिस्थितियों की एक उल्लेखनीय सहमति)
